checks: Four-piece runtime mechanics (read-only review of crates/content/src/sets/crimson/mod.rs; production code unchanged in this task): on_hit queues one ProcCallback CrimsonAtkStack grant per connected delivered wearer hit; apply() declares TimedBuffDeclaration::reset with BUFF_ID crimson.atk, BuffRecipient::SelfActor, BuffStackingScope::PerSource (native AggregateBySource), RefreshPolicy::Independent, max_stacks 6; the cap discards further grants via apply_buff without refreshing existing stacks; each stack expires on world time via a BuffTickOrExpiry event at grant time plus 10s; a crimson_atk_stack trace event is pushed for every grant attempt, including grants discarded at the cap.

Four-piece runtime oracles, hand-derived from the fixture (static ATK 1000, base ATK 1151, atk_rate 1.0, crit 0, DEF 0, RES 0) via ATK_live(n) = 1000 + 1151 * n * 3/50 (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 2), rounded half up: 0->1000, 1->1069, 2->1138, 3->1207, 4->1276, 5->1345, 6->1414. All 10 tests in crates/content/src/simulation/tests/crimson.rs pass. Two hits (0s/1s), 5s horizon: 2 stacks, aggregate atk_percent 3/25, 2 trace events, damages [1000, 1069] (the spawning hit is not buffed by its own stack; 1069 falsifies multiply-static 1060). Eight hits: 6 stacks, aggregate 9/25, damages [1000,1069,1138,1207,1276,1345,1414,1414], 8 trace events. Three hits (0s/1s/2s): 0 stacks at 25s; 2 stacks (3/25) at 10.5s, falsifying refresh-all/shared-window. Ten hits (0..9s), 14.5s horizon: 1 stack (3/50), falsifying refresh-at-cap (6) and evict-oldest (5). Switch: wearer hits at 0s/1s, switch at 2s, ally hit at 3s -> wearer keeps 2 stacks off-field, ally holds 0 stacks and its hit deals 1000 (self-recipient). A hit at exactly 10s after a 0s grant deals 1000: expiry precedes the equal-time hit. Replay parity including trace event counts; wrong set (Suit10) rejected naming set:Suit4; zero duration and max_stacks 0 rejected under the 1..=64 rule.

Four-piece parameter binding: set_passive_values::crimson (crates/data/src/set_passive_values.rs:50-57) binds Suit4 to the blueprint /Game/Blueprints/Abilities/Buff/Equipment/Equipment_006/Buff_Equipment_Incantation_4.0 and curve keys Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 (0.06/6/10) through the shared timed_set path. Honestly: no dedicated drift test pins these three curve keys for crimson; the only protection against curve drift is the generic shared path, and no runtime scenario exercises the adapter output (fixture parameters are caller-supplied).

Studio binding verified by reading only (not changed): build/studio.rs:242 compiles the crimson proc, :274 registers set_procs set:Suit4 with threshold 4, :279 registers gear_assumptions.crimson_atk with the sets.crimson_v1 hypothesis text.

ATK zone: simulation/hit/calculation.rs:55-75 computes atk_exact = static ATK + base_atk * atk_percent for the live layer, matching COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 2. The 1069 oracle falsifies the multiply-static model (would give 1060) and the 1414 cap oracle falsifies damage-zone stacking.
decision: Keep the existing 4pc proc as modeled (production code unchanged in this task). The numbers, per-stack cap, recipient, independent expiry, discard-at-cap, off-field persistence and ATK zone verify against frozen tables and hand-derived oracles; the trigger (one stack per connected delivered wearer hit) is wider than the native description and stays an explicit hypothesis.
hypothesis_rationale: The native description says stacks are granted 'when a nearby enemy takes Incantation DMG from the Team'; the model grants one stack per connected delivered wearer hit regardless of element and does not check team/ally damage, so the modeled trigger is a tested hypothesis that is strictly wider than the frozen description. The set fragment's callback_probes show GC_Buff_Equipment_Incantation calling GetCharacterElementType on a teammate, but the exact element condition is unresolved and not modeled. Tested hypotheses pinned by the 10 runtime tests (not proven as native rules): grant processed after the spawning hit's damage and before same-time queued hits; expiry before equal-time hits; discard-at-cap without refresh; independent per-stack 10s world-time expiry; off-field persistence with self-recipient. The Incantation_4_1/4_2/4_3 -> (0.06/6/10) curve binding is by name match against the description; no frozen table links the buff blueprint to its curve keys by reference.

Two hits (0s/1s), 5s horizon: stack_count 2, aggregate atk_percent 3/25, 2 crimson_atk_stack trace events, damages [1000, 1069]; the spawning hit is unbuffed (grant after delivery).
Eight hits at 1s spacing: 6 stacks held, aggregate 9/25, damages [1000,1069,1138,1207,1276,1345,1414,1414], 8 trace events (grants discarded at the cap are still traced).
Three hits (0s/1s/2s): 0 stacks at 25s; 2 stacks (aggregate 3/25) at 10.5s (midpoint falsifies refresh-all and shared-window).
Ten hits (0..9s), 14.5s horizon: 1 stack, aggregate 3/50 (falsifies refresh-at-cap=6 and evict-oldest=5).

Switch scenario: wearer hits at 0s/1s, SwitchActor at 2s, ally hit at 3s, 5s horizon -> wearer (owner_actor 0) keeps 2 stacks; ally (owner_actor 1) holds 0 stacks and its hit deals 1000 (self-recipient; allies grant nothing).
Boundary: hit at 0s plus a hit at exactly 10_000_000us -> second hit deals 1000 (expiry processed before the equal-time hit); the second hit's own stack survives at the 15s horizon (stack_count 1).
Config validation: set:Suit10 rejected with an error naming set:Suit4; duration_us 0 rejected with an error naming duration; max_stacks 0 rejected under the 1..=64 rule.
Replay: identical hit_receipts, final buff instances and crimson_atk_stack trace counts across two runs.
limits: The modeled trigger (one stack per connected delivered wearer hit) is a tested hypothesis wider than the native description ('when a nearby enemy takes Incantation DMG from the Team'); team/ally-triggered stacks are not modeled or tested.

The native element condition is unresolved: the set fragment's callback_probes show GC_Buff_Equipment_Incantation calling GetCharacterElementType on a teammate, but the exact check is not decoded and not modeled.

Trigger timing (grant after the spawning hit's damage, before same-time queued hits), expiry-before-equal-time-hits, discard-at-cap without refresh, independent per-stack expiry and off-field persistence are tested hypotheses, not verified native rules.

The runtime fixture uses caller-supplied parameters (3/50, 10s, 6); the native values reach the proc only through the set_passive_values::crimson adapter binding, which has no dedicated drift test (shared timed_set path only) and is not exercised by any runtime scenario.
